ns2:section.sectionText: Academic Outreach restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.outreach.uiuc.edu. This online course starts January 21 and ends May 6. The Elluminate online conferencing system will be used to deliver five synchronous (real-time) class sessions that will occur on Thursday evenings from 6:00 to 8:00 PM. There will also be 3 face-to-face classes held on the University of Illinois at Springfield campus. The first face-to-face class will be held in the University Hall building (room 2034) and the second and third site-based classes will be held in the WUIS building (room 50) on Thursday evenings (January 21, March 18 and April 29) from 6:00 to 9:00 PM. Classes end April 29, the midterm exam will be taken online on March 11, and the final is a take home exam that will be submitted online by May 6. The email address for the instructor is backerso@illinois.edu.
ns2:section.sectionFeeAmount: OCE Tuition $386.00 per Bill Hour, and OCE Fees $45.00 per Bill Hour.
